item.content:encoded:
Russian-Turkish Relations in the Context of Regional Crises: The Limits of Rapprochement

发布源: 47. Russian International Affairs Council (RIAC) --Russia | 抓取时间: 2026-11-24

Login if you are already registered

Junior Research Fellow, Center for Strategic Planning Studies, IMEMO

Short versionof the article

Full versionof the article

The “strategic partnership” between Russia and Turkey, as a characterization of bilateral relations between Moscow and Ankara, has long been a formula whose variables multiply with each passing year. Over time, the traditional issues of regional security, trade, and energy have acquired more and more nuances that test the resilience of these relations. Divergences are particularly evident on regional issues: alongside the Middle East and the South Caucasus, which have long been points of contention, the security of navigation in the Black Sea is increasingly becoming a stumbling block.

Turkey’s multivector diplomacy allows it to strengthen partnerships both with Russia and with countries pursuing policies hostile to Russia. Compartmentalizing the bilateral agenda enables Moscow and Ankara to find common ground on issues where their positions diverge. Yet a willingness to engage in dialogue by no means implies acceptance of either side’s preferred outcome.

The prospects for Russian-Turkish relations will depend on whether Ankara and Moscow can continue to find common ground as their involvement in regional crises follows increasingly divergent paths. item.description: 网站专栏报告。作者: 智库研究员。这篇智库文章初次发表在32. Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy, FKA Institute for the Economy in Transition --Russia官方网站上。
item.content:encoded:
Monitoring legal regulation of the digital economy

发布源: 32. Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy, FKA Institute for the Economy in Transition --Russia | 抓取时间: 2026-11-24

Starting from 2024, Gaidar Institute launched a monthly review of international trends in the legal regulation of the digital economy. The purpose of Monitoring is to timely identify key developments and trends in the global practice of regulating the digital sector. The scientific and expert analysis allows not only to track current changes, but also to forecast their potential impact on the development of the digital industry in our country, contributing to the formation of an adaptive and effective strategy of legal regulation in this area.

It is published in Russian and English.
